items.title: Nvidia launches investigation into CEO's affair with suspected Chinese spy
novel_facts: Additional quote from Rubio declining to comment en route to G7
China's Foreign Ministry spokesperson reiterating denial of espionage claims
items.reason: This covers the same investigation, same CEO, same alleged spy relationship, and same Trump comments already reported in the canonical NBC article. The added Rubio and Chinese foreign ministry quotes are supplementary color/reaction, not a material new development (no arrest, ruling, identification, or consequential change), so it should update rather than fork into a new story.
